inspect_fits.backend: Core with Astropy and NumPy. PNG quicklook uses Matplotlib. The limited NumPy fallback inspects the primary image.

inputs.detail: Readable original or copied FITS file with one or more HDUs.
HDU name or zero-based index for preview and pixel lookup.
Preview region as x0,y0,width,height. Its origin is zero-based.
Zero-based x,y in the original image. A cube uses its first plane. Values retain the declared BUNIT where available.
Additional FITS keyword to retain. May be repeated.
Positive approximate sample size for image statistics.
Maximum table columns described per HDU.
Requires --preview. Retains a diagnostic and summary if the bounded quicklook is unavailable.
Use the limited primary-image reader. Full HDU, WCS and pixel lookup support require Astropy.

outputs.detail: HDU descriptions, sampled data statistics, headers and available WCS.
Display-only quicklook when the selected image can be rendered.
Input and completed output records and processing parameters.

inspect_fits.warnings: Unavailable bounded quicklooks and low finite-pixel coverage can produce WARNING with a retained summary.
inspect_fits.failure: Unavailable or unreadable input and invalid coordinates can exit 2 with a diagnostic summary when its destination is writable.

catalog_workbench.crossmatch-sky.backend: Core with Astropy, NumPy and SciPy for nearest-neighbour celestial matching.

inputs.detail: Left catalog with at least one row and separate RA and Dec columns.
Right catalog with the same coordinate frame and epoch as the left catalog. The guided form accepts text tables.
Optional reader format for the left catalog.
Optional reader format for the right catalog.
Name of the RA column in the left catalog.
Name of the left declination column.
Name of the RA column in the right catalog.
Name of the right declination column.
Angular unit for the left RA column.
Angular unit for the right RA column.
Angular unit for the left Dec column.
Angular unit for the right Dec column.
ICRS for both inputs.
Positive common epoch if supplied. Required by the guided form. Positions are used as supplied.
Finite positive search radius up to 648000 arcseconds.

outputs.detail: Nearest accepted right-side match per left row, with match_sep_arcsec. The guided form writes ECSV.
Input and match counts, mapping and angular separation QA.
Both catalog input records, completed outputs and matching parameters.

catalog_workbench.crossmatch-sky.warnings: Empty matches, a search radius above one degree, and repeated use of one right row can yield WARNING.
catalog_workbench.crossmatch-sky.failure: Invalid input, coordinate metadata, or an unwritable destination can exit 2. Output aliases of inputs are rejected on standard output before writing any files.

photometry_noise_budget.backend: Python numerical model. No catalog, aperture image or external detector backend is required.

inputs.detail: Common unit of source, sky and dark counts.
Finite non-negative net source signal within the aperture.
Finite non-negative background sky level.
Finite non-negative integrated dark contribution.
Positive detector gain when using ADU.

inputs.unit: electrons RMS per pixel per frame
inputs.detail: Finite non-negative read noise in either input count unit mode.
Positive effective aperture area. Fractional pixels are supported.
Positive effective background sample area for the background-estimation variance term.
Positive integer count of combined frames.

outputs.detail: Variance components in electrons squared, total noise in electrons and dimensionless SNR.
Legacy summary destination used when --summary-json is absent.
Noise budget, assumptions and QA in a readable report.
Parameter and output records for the completed calculation.

photometry_noise_budget.warnings: Omitting background estimation or producing zero variance can yield WARNING. SNR is null when total noise is zero.
photometry_noise_budget.failure: Invalid values or numerical overflow exit 2. The diagnostic retains empty measurements and the reason.

photometric_solution.backend: Core in the dedicated datanalysis environment. NumPy and pandas fit the model, with Astropy table support and Matplotlib for the residual plot.

inputs.detail: Standard-star table such as CSV, TSV, ECSV or FITS. Use one consistent magnitude system and passband per fit.
Instrumental magnitude column.
Catalog or standard magnitude column.
Airmass column for fitting extinction.
Color index column for the optional color term.
Positive uncertainty on the standard minus instrumental magnitude difference for weighted fitting.
Fit a linear color coefficient when the color column is supplied.

outputs.detail: Coefficients, method, uncertainties or null, residuals and QA.
Optional additional copy of the same summary.
Fitted coefficients with their units and uncertainties.
Per-standard fit diagnostics and residuals in mag.
Method, fit diagnostics and quality flags.
Input and completed output records for the solution.

photometric_solution.warnings: Sparse coverage, high residual scatter or uncertain coefficients can produce WARNING. The extinction sign follows the standard-minus-instrumental convention.
photometric_solution.failure: Unreadable, insufficient or rank-deficient standards can exit 2 with an empty coefficient set and a diagnostic.
